title: Masses of S and T agree on every set disjoint from a set containing spt(S − T)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be currents in U (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U n), and let K, G ⊆ ℝ^P be sets with spt(S − T) ⊆ K and G ∩ K = ∅. Here S − T is the difference current of the frozen contract, (S − T)(ω) = S(ω) − T(ω) for ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); spt R = U ∖ Z_R is the support of a current R ∈ 𝒟_n(U), where Z_R is the union of all open W ⊆ ℝ^P with closure(W) compact, closure(W) ⊆ U and R(η) = 0 for every η ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport η ⊆ W (GeometricCurrentOn.support, Simon Ch. 6, 2.11); and for a current R ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and a set G, M_G(R) := sup{max(R(ω), 0) : ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), tsupport ω ⊆ G, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} ∈ [0, ∞] (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn.massOn, |·| the Euclidean coefficient norm of n-covectors, Simon 6.2.5). Then M_G(S) = M_G(T).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (K G : Set (Euclid P)), (S - T).support ⊆ K → Disjoint G K → S.massOn G = T.massOn G
